text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, and thrombocytopenia. There is mild elevation of CRP and ferritin, suggesting inflammation. Basophils are elevated. Cardiac and liver markers are within normal limits. Renal function, electrolytes, and coagulation are unremarkable. Findings may indicate acute or chronic inflammatory or infectious process, possible bone marrow suppression, and require clinical correlation and further investigation.
